page.content:
World-tree that holds Asgard, Midgard, and the other realms.

How Yggdrasil connects

  • Topic: Norse mythology — Yggdrasil is the world-tree of Norse myth.
  • Location: Asgard — Asgard is one of the worlds held in Yggdrasil.
  • Location: Midgard — Midgard hangs on Yggdrasil as the human enclosure.
  • Location: Jotunheim — Jotunheim is the giant-world on the tree.
  • Location: Helheim — Helheim lies among the dead-worlds of the tree.

What is Yggdrasil?

Yggdrasil is the ash whose roots and branches bind the nine worlds. Gods and creatures meet at its well; it shudders when Ragnarok nears.

Key threads lead to Norse mythology, Asgard, Midgard, Jotunheim and Helheim.
